maxRps.rationale: Prose gives no specific admission ceiling, so use a large typical API gateway/load-balancer limit well above current 500 rps.

instances.rationale: Prose states requests go through 8 instances of the order service.

concurrencyPerInstance.rationale: No concurrency limit given, so use a typical per-instance worker/thread concurrency for a stateless synchronous service.

serviceTimeMs.rationale: Includes order validation plus the synchronous call out to the payment provider, which counts as service time since the request isn't done until that call returns; no explicit latency given so a typical combined validation + third-party payment round-trip is used.

connectionPoolSize.rationale: Prose states Postgres connections are unpooled by an external pooler and capped at 40 connections.

queryTimeMs.rationale: No query latency given, so use a typical Postgres write-query execution time.

writeRatio.rationale: Prose states almost all traffic is writes (placing new orders), not reads, so writeRatio is near 1.

readReplicas.rationale: Prose states two read replicas run off the primary.

replicaApplyRate.rationale: No sustained replica apply throughput given, so use a typical value for a write-heavy Postgres streaming replica.
